rows.grounds: fused form of annam (food) + ca (and) + eva (indeed); accusative object
genitive plural indicating the source or group concerned

items.question: From whom must food be strictly avoided by the practitioner?
premises: Food is explicitly marked as the object of restriction.
The restriction applies universally to all persons.
items.inference: The practitioner is enjoined to avoid accepting food from everyone.
uncertainties: The scope of sarveṣāṃ (all people without exception or all of a specific group) is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O great goddess, one should indeed avoid the food of all.
